finding_disposition.finding: Concurrent staging can exceed the hard quota and leak lease reservations.
implementation: UidAccounting synchronizes reserve's validation and insertion, release, and used queries on one instance lock.
StagingLeaseManager serializes lease-file creation, callback registration, explicit release, and expiry cleanup on one lease lock. Cleanup removes and invokes a callback while holding that lock.

concurrency_tests.name: SegmentStoreTest.uid_accounting_serializes_concurrent_hard_quota_reservations
concurrency_tests.method: Two ExecutorService worker threads wait on CountDownLatch barriers then concurrently reserve 10 bytes against a one-file/10-byte hard SNAPSHOTS quota.
concurrency_tests.assertions_per_iteration: Exactly one reservation succeeds and final used(SNAPSHOTS) is exactly 10 bytes.

concurrency_tests.name: ExportWorkflowTest.staging_registration_and_expiry_cleanup_release_each_concurrent_lease_once
concurrency_tests.method: A stage worker and cleanup worker run on separate ExecutorService threads. A host-test hook holds staging after the expired file is written but before callback registration; CountDownLatch barriers make cleanup contend for the lease lock.
concurrency_tests.assertions_per_iteration: Cleanup finds one expired file and the lease reservation release callback runs exactly once.
